I'll wait a bit and then check the status again. In the meantime, I'll review the remaining parts of AGENTS.md and take a look at the script/ directory.

Also, something to keep in mind: the container name is... the compose project is "zammad-devcontainer". The devcontainer container mounts ../../.. = /workspace to /workspaces. Wait — in the case of the devcontainer, the host mount is `../../..:/workspaces`. /workspace/.devcontainer/default -> ../../.. = /workspace. OK, so /workspaces/workspace inside the container = /workspace on the host. And the devcontainer's workspaceFolder is /workspaces/${localWorkspaceFolderBasename} = /workspaces/workspace.

Now, while the pull is happening, let me investigate the scripts needed for the app: script/vite-server.rb, script/rails, script/websocket-server.rb, script/background-worker.rb, and vite.config.mjs to understand what vite dev does (VITE_RUBY_HOST=127.0.0.1, the vite dev server probably runs on port 3001 or somewhere).

Also, let me check the requirements in config/environments/development.rb.
